messages:
eli: heads-up — spotted a 'stashlink' token in a partner webhook backup (saw it in a gzipped log blob). not sure of scope yet :eyes:
maya: can you paste the line (sanitized) and where it was found?
eli: path: gs://partner-logs/2026/03/21/ingest-archive.gz, grep snippet: `curl -H \"Authorization: Stashlink st_xxxREDACTEDxxx\" https://api.partner.example/`
raj: that token looks long-lived, not ephemeral. partner said they rotate daily but this one didn't match pattern.
maya: if it's in partner logs we need containment + rotation + audit. recommend: 1) ask partner to revoke, 2) scrub logs, 3) confirm any downstream tokens derived from it.
eli: agreed. opening containment checklist now. security_bot: New incident created: INC-2026-129 (stashlink token exposure). Owner: eng-security
ops_oncall: i'll take the scrub run. which buckets/objects to remove vs redact?
eli: remove sensitive copies if they are backups; for retention we can replace object with redacted stub. command i'm going to run (dry-run first):
```
# find occurrences
gsutil cp gs://partner-logs/2026/03/21/ingest-archive.gz - | zgrep -n "st_" || true
# to redact
gsutil cp /dev/null gs://partner-logs/2026/03/21/ingest-archive.gz
```
maya: also, we need to check Vault for any secrets that reference partner token or have been created around that timestamp. search paths: secret/data/partners/* and transit/keys/partner-*.
raj: i'm pulling audit logs now. looks like two internal services called the partner endpoint using that token at 03:12 and 03:17 UTC. call graph points to a legacy sync lambda.
eli: legacy sync lambda = svc-sync-legacy in infra account; it uses a KMS-wrapped blob in GCS for credentials. we need to rekey and rotate any wrapping keys if the lambda stored the token.
ops_oncall: on it. plan: (A) partner revokes token; (B) scrub partner logs; (C) rotate KMS wrapping key for svc-sync-legacy; (D) create short-lived service identity and update lambda to fetch via Vault (no long-lived tokens). timeline: ASAP for A/B, 6 hours for C/D.
maya: RBAC change request: restrict read on partner-logs bucket to only ingestion service principal and infra-service accounts. add a deny for legacy sync lambda. i'll draft IR change PR.
raj: audit logging note — enable dataAccess logs for storage in partner project if not already. we have gaps for 03/21; need to surface who accessed the blob before revocation.
eli: priority: locate any downstream exposure (Slack, S3, internal dumps). patch script to grep S3, GCS, and archived DB columns for st_ patterns. i'll post script in the incident doc.
security_bot: Audit event: storage.objects.get detected from svc-sync-legacy@infra at 2026-03-21T03:12:07Z (object: ingest-archive.gz)
ops_oncall: scrub dry-run passed, no integrity issues. scheduling final overwrite in T-10 minutes. will coordinate with partner to avoid breaking live ingestion.
maya: once scrubbed, we should rotate Vault role credentials that might have been minted by the legacy lambda. set TTLs to 1h for the new role.
raj: rewrap plan for KMS key: create new key ring key kms-us-west1/rewrap-2026-03-21, update GCS wrapped blob via `gcloud kms encrypt --key=...` and push. also update IAM to remove legacy role.
eli: can someone run a quick grep across recent CI logs for `st_` tokens? risk of commit history leak.
ops_oncall: im running the CI grep: `git log --all -p | grep -E '\\bst_[A-Za-z0-9]+' -n` will report if any commits.
maya: i'll open a short PR that tightening vault policies and adds an audit-trigger rule: if a partner secret is requested outside known service identities, auto-block and alert.
eli: post-mortem actions (short list): 1) confirm partner revocation 2) scrub/rewrite backups 3) rotate KMS wrapping key + Vault role creds 4) RBAC tighten on partner logs 5) enable/verify storage dataAccess logs 6) deploy short-lived credentials pattern and update legacy lambda 7) 72h monitoring window with elevated alerts
raj: adding note: check partner onboarding docs — they used to supply a long-lived token for sync. we need to update onboarding checklist to require short-lived OAuth or Vault integration.
ops_oncall: scrub complete, partner confirmed revocation. no downstream commits found in CI.
eli: thanks team. i'll file the incident report and the postmortem doc tomorrow. tagging followups: @maya (RBAC PR), @raj (KMS rewrap), @ops_oncall (lambda update + CI checks). :thumbsup:
